mapper.sql: callback_id AS callbackId, instance_id AS instanceId, node_run_id AS nodeRunId, trigger_code AS triggerCode, callback_type AS callbackType, target, status, attempt_count AS attemptCount, last_error AS lastError, sent_time AS sentTime, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_workflow_callback (callback_id, instance_id, node_run_id, trigger_code, callback_type, target, status, attempt_count, last_error, sent_time, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.callbackId}, #{row.instanceId}, #{row.nodeRunId}, #{row.triggerCode}, #{row.callbackType}, #{row.target}, #{row.status}, #{row.attemptCount}, #{row.lastError}, #{row.sentTime}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_workflow_callback WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY create_time, callback_id
